## Brand icons

Brand marks identify supported connectors and do not imply endorsement or
affiliation. The original artwork colors are retained without tinting or filters.

- Gmail and Drive: Google's official 2026 product artwork, from the
  [Gmail asset](https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/productlogos/gmail_2026/v1/192px.svg)
  and [Drive asset](https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/productlogos/drive_2026/v1/192px.svg).
  See Google's [brand guidance](https://knowledge.workspace.google.com/admin/getting-started/brand-your-internal-communications-with-google-workspace).
- Slack and Outlook: original multicolor SVGs distributed by
  [SVGL](https://github.com/pheralb/svgl), with its
  [MIT license retained](../icons/SVGL-LICENSE.txt).
- GitHub and Notion: Simple Icons 11.15.0, with the
  [CC0 dedication retained](../icons/LICENSE.md).
